discovery_notes: Pass 4 gap-fill, 40 searches. grownupmagic.com hit for Sam Eagle/Madam Mim/A-2-Z was a WDWNT re-publish and was not used. Disney Pinventory claims are secondary only (no codes taken). Disney Pin Forum Windows of Attraction post mirrors Disney Pins Blog wording, so marked derived_from. Muppets MK pin: Laughing Place says mini jumbo vs target name jumbo. Wondrous Worlds Ariel adds Flounder. Pirates Charming Carousels source is a Disneyland Resort flyer though key is WDW. Disney Store HSM Wildcats 20th LE 3700 seen but described as Disney Store-created, not tied to the parks pin, so not claimed. No prompt-injection content seen.
